The '''granddaughter''' of [[Borjak]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] from [[Odryn]]. She had a short conversation with [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Marn Hierogryph]] while they were imprisoned by the Feeorin. In the aftermath of the destruction of the [[Sanctum of the Exalted|Sanctum]] and the death of the [[Feln|current]] [[Exalted]], Borjak had his granddaughter throw Feln's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into the rubble.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In his notes, [[John Jackson Miller]] confirmed that Borjak's granddaughter has a name but refused to mention it for now.<ref name="Faraway-Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #30">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor30.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #30''}}</ref>
